items.text: Orwo eboma yabaire yayombekirwe, natairemu enyigi, ntaho abakumilizi b'ebihigi, n'abahoyi, n'Abalevita.
Nataho murumuna wange Hanani, na Hanania omulebelezi w'eboma kutwara Yerusalemu. Hanania akaba ali mwesigwa, mara mushaija alikutina Ruhanga kukira bangi.

Mbaragira nti, “Ebihigi bya Yerusalemu bitakukingurwa kulemwa kuhika aha kashana matagata; kandi enyigi zikingwe n'okutekwaho emihingo abakumilizi batakainukire bwaigoro. Abalinzi mubaihye omu banyansi ba Yerusalemu, buli muntu mumute omu maisho g'enjuye.”
Ekigo kikaba kili kingi mara kihango, kyonkai abantu ababaire bakilimu bakaba bali bake, n'amaju gakaba gatakombekirwe.

Aho Ruhanga yantamu ekitekelezo ky'okuchumbiza abakungu n'abakuru n'embaga kuhurura kuhandikwa kuhonderana n'amahiga gabo. Nkwasa ekitabo ky'embara eky'amahiga g'abarugire mbere omu buzahe, nshanga kihandikirwemu kiti:
Aba nibo bantu b'omukoa abarugire omu buzahe, abo Nebukadineza omukama wa Babiloni yabaire atwete endore. Bagaruka Yerusalemu na Yuda buli muntu omu kigokye.
Bakaija na Zerubabeli, Yeshua, Nehemia, Seraya, Reelaya, Nahamani, Moridekai, Birashani, Misipereti, Bigwai, Rehumu na Bana. Oru nirwo rubara rw'abashaija omuli Isiraeli:
Eihiga lya Pahatimoabu nibo baijukuru ba Yeshua na Yoabu 2,818.
Eihiga lya Ateri, baijukuru ba Hezekia 98.
Abashaija ba Kiriatiyearimu, Kefira na Beroti 743.
Eihiga lya Lodi, Hadidi na Ono 721.
Abakuhani: Eihiga lya Yedaya, nibo baijukuru ba Yeshua 973.
Abalevita: Eihiga lya Yeshua eya Kadimielia, nibo baijukuru ba Hodavia 74.
Abakumilizi b'ebihigi: Amahiga ga Shalumu, Ateri, Talumoni, Akubu, Hatita na Shobai 138.
Abakozi ba Rwensinga: Amahiga ga Siha, Hasufu, Tabaoti,
Amahiga g'abaramata ba Solomoni: Amahiga ga Sotai, Sofereti, Perida,
Abakozi bona ba Rwensinga n'ab'omu mahiga g'abaramata ba Solomoni, bakaba bali 392.
Abarugire omu bigo bya Telimela, Telaharasha, Kerubu, Adoni na Imeri, kyonkai tibashoboire kumanya mahiga gabo anga ntabuko yabo nka babaire bali BaIsiraeli, nib'aba:
Amahiga ga Delaya, Tobia na Nekoda 642.
Kandi omu bakuhani: Amahiga ga Hobaya, Hakosi, Barizilai (ayabaire ashweire muhara wa Barizilai Omugileadi, mara aketwa eibara lyabo).
Abo bakahiga mbali bahandikirwe kuhonderana n'amahiga gabo, kyonkai tibabonekiremu, aha rw'ekyo bakashororwa omu bakuhani ngu nibazira.
akabatanga kulya aha kyakulya ekitakatifu muno kuhika orwo omukuhani aina Urimu na Tumimu yakuzokire.
Embaga yona hamoi bakaba bali bantu 42,360.
Kandi abairu babo n'abazana ababaire bali 7,337 batabulimu. Abahoyi abashaija n'abakazi 245.
Abamoiho omu bakuru b'amahiga gabo bakagira omuchango gw'eikora. Gavana akateka omuli buhanika ekilo 8,000 z'ezahabu, n'enyabya 50 n'enyambarwa 530 z'abakuhani.
Kandi abakuru b'amahiga abandi bateka omuli buhanika y'eikora ekilo 168 z'ezahabu n'ekilo 1,250 z'efeza.
Eby'abantu abasigaire bagizire kilo 168 z'ezahabu, ekilo 140 z'efeza n'enyambarwa 67 z'abakuhani.
Kityo abakuhani, Abalevita, abakumilizi b'ebihigi, abahoyi, abantu abandi abakozi ba Rwensinga na Isiraeli yona batura omu bigo byabo.
Omwezi gwa mushanju kagwagobire, Abaisiraeli bakaba batwire omu bigo byabo.
